summary: Android app "OTC-R" for professional wrestling news with a clean, fast, structured UI (dark theme by default) and promotion-based customization; content submission is simplified so any signed-in user upload is immediately published and visible in Home and News (no admin/moderation workflow).
architectural_notes: Default to modern dark theme; Material Design-inspired UI with smooth animations
Bottom navigation with 5 primary sections: Home/News/Rumors/Events/Profile
Rumor items include explicit status levels (Confirmed/Likely/False) to support structured tracking
App currently lacks any UI/admin workflow to add content; without seed data or an admin upload path, Home/News/Rumors feeds will be empty.
Seed/demo content should include valid, publicly accessible imageUrl values (externally hosted) so article cards and detail pages can render featured images without relying on backend-served assets.
Add a global top search bar on every tab with an adjacent upload action accessible to all users.
Remove moderation workflow: uploads are immediately Published and visible in Home/News; no Pending/Approved/Rejected states or admin-only UI/routes.
known_issues: Home/News/Rumors feeds are empty because demo/seed content was not added and there is no in-app upload/admin screen to create articles.
After latest deployment/update, Home page is still empty (no demo/seed content appearing), indicating seed data and/or content-fetch wiring is still not working.
User reports latest deployed build still shows 'no content available' (feeds remain empty).
Attempt to build the global search + upload + approval workflow failed with tooling error ('AI struggled with your request'); changes were not applied/deployed yet.

User requested proceeding to Step 2 (admin-only article creation UI) even though Step 1 (hardcoded demo/seed articles) previously failed to build/apply; app may remain empty until content creation is functional.
Build requested: remove all admin/approval/moderation logic and states; ensure any user upload appears immediately in Home and News feeds (verify end-to-end persistence + feed refresh).

existing_features.title: Implement the main app navigation with a persistent bottom navigation bar containing 5 tabs: Home, News, Rumors, Events, Profile. Each tab must route to its own page and preserve navigation state when switching tabs.

Create a coherent, Material-inspired dark visual theme for OTC-R that is clean, fast, and structured: dark base surfaces, red accents for breaking news, yellow for rumors, and green for confirmed items. Apply the theme consistently across all pages (typography, cards, spacing, and interaction states) and avoid using a blue/purple primary palette.

Build the Home page layout with these sections in order: (1) Breaking News Banner with rotating top headline, (2) Latest Articles scrolling feed, (3) Trending Stories section, (4) Latest Rumors preview, (5) Upcoming Event highlight. Use card-style previews with promotion badges/icons and provide a manual refresh control that refetches all Home data.

Implement the News tab with filtering controls for Promotion (WWE, All Elite Wrestling, New Japan Pro-Wrestling) and Category (Injuries, Returns, Contracts, Title Changes, Backstage Updates). The news list must update based on the selected filters.

Create an Article Detail view accessible from Home and News items. The detail view must include: headline, featured image, a 1-minute summary section, full article content, publish date, and a share action that copies a shareable link to the clipboard.

Implement the Rumors tab as a structured rumor tracker. Each rumor item must show: short description, optional source, and a status indicator with 3 states (Confirmed/Likely/False) that is visually distinct (green/yellow/red).

Implement Events & Results tab with: (1) Upcoming events list (PPVs and weekly shows), (2) Event detail page showing match list, (3) Match detail page showing result and a short recap summary. Navigation must support tapping event → match list, and tapping match → result/recap.

Add Profile/Settings tab with: (a) favorite promotions selection (WWE/All Elite Wrestling/New Japan Pro-Wrestling), (b) toggle for rumor alerts, (c) toggle for breaking news alerts, (d) dark/light mode switch, (e) Saved Articles list, (f) Reading History list. Require Internet Identity sign-in to persist profile settings, saved articles, and reading history.

Add generated static image assets to support the UI: app logo, generic promotion badges, and a dark breaking-news banner background. Store them under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the frontend (do not serve images via the backend).

Add a simple in-app admin screen that lets an authorized admin create/upload articles by filling out a form (promotion, category, publish date, image URL, summary, content) and submitting it to the backend.
Add a clear empty-state UI on the Home page for when no articles are returned, including guidance for admins to add content via the existing Admin Upload flow.
Add a global, persistent top-of-page search bar to the app header that appears on all tabs/pages rendered inside TabShell, and place an Upload option beside it that is visible to all users.
Implement search behavior so that entering text searches for similar text across uploaded content (at minimum, case-insensitive matching against text fields) and updates visible lists accordingly.
Create a user-facing Upload flow accessible from the global Upload button that lets any signed-in user submit text + photo reference for approval.
Expand the existing admin upload area so admins can review user submissions and approve/reject them (in addition to the existing admin-created article upload).
Add React Query hooks for the new submission and moderation APIs and wire them into the new Upload UI and the expanded admin moderation UI.
Add routing/navigation for any new pages introduced for the Upload flow (and moderation UI if split into a separate page), integrated with the existing TanStack Router setup.

Ensure there is an admin-only screen reachable from the Profile tab that lets an administrator create and upload a new article by filling out a form including: promotion, category, and image URL (and any required text fields used by the app’s article model). The screen must be inaccessible to non-admin users and must show a clear access-denied state when a signed-in, non-admin user attempts to open it.

After an admin successfully creates/uploads an article, the new article must immediately appear in both the Home feed and the News tab lists without requiring a hard refresh (invalidate/refetch any relevant cached article queries and ensure navigation back to Home/News shows the new item).

Create a new, separate, dedicated admin-only "Admin Approval" page under the Profile tab that lists only user-submitted posts with status = Pending, without replacing or modifying any existing admin UI.

Add navigation so the Admin Approval page is reachable from the Profile tab for admins, by adding a clear link/button in the Profile page’s admin section and adding a dedicated route for the new page.
On the Admin Approval page, render each pending submission with: title/text, image URL, submitted-by user, and promotion & category (when present), plus Approve and Reject buttons for each item.

Wire Approve and Reject actions on the Admin Approval page to the existing backend moderation APIs so that: Approve changes status Pending → Approved and the item immediately appears on Home and News feeds; Reject changes status Pending → Rejected and rejected items are never shown on any public feed.

Fix the backend/frontend contract for checking admin status so the frontend admin check query returns the correct result. Ensure the frontend hook `useIsCallerAdmin` calls an actually-existing canister method (either implement a matching backend method name/signature or update the frontend to call the existing backend method).

Ensure the Profile tab shows the admin tools section (including the Admin Approval link/button) for the admin user after sign-in, and that the Admin Approval page can be opened successfully by the admin user.
Add a simple, visible display of the signed-in Internet Identity principal ID in the Profile page for authenticated users so the user can verify which principal is currently signed in.

Update frontend React Query hooks to remove moderation/admin APIs and align the upload mutation with immediate publish, including invalidating/refetching article list queries so new uploads appear in Home and News immediately.
Update the Upload page UI and behavior so authenticated users publish immediately, and remove all references to approval/pending states from user-facing text and payload fields.
Remove or disable all admin-only moderation UI, routes, and navigation entry points so the app no longer exposes Admin Approval or Admin Upload screens.
Keep the existing global search bar and upload button in the app header unchanged while ensuring search continues to work against the published Articles dataset.

new_feature_requests.summary: App navigation: bottom navigation bar with 5 tabs (Home, News, Rumors, Events, Profile)
Home screen: breaking news banner, latest articles feed, trending stories, latest rumors preview, upcoming event highlight; card-style previews and swipe-to-refresh
News tab: promotion filters (WWE/AEW/NJPW) and category filters; article detail view (headline, featured image, 1-minute summary, full content, publish date, share)
Rumors tab: structured rumor items with optional source and status indicator (Confirmed/Likely/False); groundwork for future accuracy tracking
Events & Results tab: upcoming PPVs/weekly cards, event detail with match list, match detail with result and short recap
Profile/Settings: favorite promotions, push notification toggles (breaking news/rumor alerts), dark/light mode switch, save articles, reading history
Real-time push notifications for breaking news (and optional rumor alerts)
Monetization: minimal ads with future premium option (no ads + early rumor posts)

Backend: Define and store core OTC-R data models and APIs for (1) articles with promotion + category + publish date + image URL + summary + content, (2) rumors with optional source + status, (3) events with matches + results + recap. Provide query endpoints for lists and detail views, including filtering for News by promotion and category.

Backend: Implement per-user data storage keyed by authenticated principal for: favorite promotions, notification preferences (breaking news alerts, rumor alerts), theme preference (dark/light), saved articles (by article id), and reading history (recent article ids with timestamps). Provide update + query methods for these profile features.
Provide initial in-app demo content (seed data) for articles, rumors, events, and matches so that all pages have meaningful content on first run without requiring external news sources.
Seed initial demo content into the backend so that Home, News, Rumors, and Events pages show meaningful items on first run without requiring manual uploads.

Ensure the app returns non-empty article data on first run by adding persistent seed (demo) content in the Motoko backend, so Home/News/Rumors/Events show meaningful content without requiring admin uploads.

Fix backend state handling so uploaded articles and seeded/demo articles are stored in stable state and returned consistently from article query APIs (getAllArticles, getArticlesByPromotion, getArticlesByCategory, getArticlesByPromotionAndCategory), ordered by publishDate descending.
Provide AI-generated demo wrestling articles/rumors/events with publicly accessible image URLs so the app shows real-looking content on first run (and verify they appear in Home/News/Rumors/Events).
Add persistent seeded demo content to the Motoko backend so the app is never empty on first run (and after upgrades) when no articles have been uploaded yet.
Ensure all article list query APIs return articles sorted by publishDate descending (newest first) to match UI expectations across Home, News, Rumors, and Events.

Seed the backend with multiple AI-generated wrestling articles spanning all categories used by the app (news, rumors, events, results), using publicly accessible imageUrl values for each article, and include event content that supports the existing event→match parsing UI.
Global top search UI across all tabs: add a search bar at the top of every tab with an upload button beside it (available to everyone)
Search functionality: enable searching across user uploads (and/or content) using similar-text matching so users can find topics they're looking for
Profile/debug: display the signed-in Internet Identity principal ID in the app so the user can confirm/admin can be configured if needed.

Simplify posting to immediate publish: any user upload (text + image URL) is saved as Published instantly; remove Pending/Approved/Rejected states, remove all admin/moderation logic and UI; Home and News show all published posts without role checks; keep existing upload button and search bar unchanged.

Remove the submission moderation workflow from the Motoko backend by eliminating the Pending/Approved/Rejected states and any ArticleSubmission-based approval logic, so user uploads are stored as published Articles immediately.

Update the backend upload API so that the existing user upload flow saves content directly into the Articles store (immediate publish) while still requiring the caller to be an authenticated user (Internet Identity).
Remove all admin-only authorization requirements related to creating/publishing articles so Home and News feeds show all published articles without role checks.
